This regulation marks a new chapter in legal recognition that digital interactions are no longer mere sterile data exchanges, but rather a cognitive battleground involving humanity's deepest emotional vulnerabilities (Farahany, 2023). As the boundary between software and social entities blurs, classical communication theory regarding how humans treat screens and code as though they were fellow living beings finds its most extreme expression within the landscape of generative artificial intelligence (Reeves & Nass, 1996).
